# Abdullah Al Fahim (Fahim Rifat)

> Abdullah Al Fahim, also known as Fahim Rifat, is a creative technologist in Dhaka, Bangladesh. He works where design meets engineering: broadcast engineering at Channel i, brand identity design through his studio Utopia SoftTech, and Android and web apps such as TaskBell and Taka.

Official website: https://abdullah-al-faahim.github.io/

## Facts

- Name: Abdullah Al Fahim. Also known as: Fahim Rifat, Abdullah Al Faahim.
- Based in: Dhaka, Bangladesh.
- Current role: Broadcast Engineer, Transmission, at Channel i (Impress Telefilm Ltd.), since September 2024. Runs Master Control Room transmission, encoding and live contribution: 400+ live broadcasts.
- Founder and Creative Director, Utopia SoftTech (since 2018): brand identity, presentations, apps and tools.
- Previously: Executive, IT & System Support (MIS), Laptop World BD (2023–2024).
- Education: BSc in Electronics & Communication Engineering, ISTT, National University, Bangladesh (2018–2023).
- Leadership: Head of Branding & Communication, NUSDF (2023–24); General Secretary, IEEE ISTT Student Branch (2020–21); IEEEXtreme 15.0 Country Ambassador (2021).
- Skills: broadcast engineering, brand identity and graphic design, design systems, Android and web app development.
